name: Juno
notes: Juno publishes no IMAP server — POP3 only. Set “Delete email from server” to Never so a second device and webmail can still see your mail.
Outgoing mail needs authentication: tick Require Sign-in on the SMTP server.
Juno’s help pages have not been revised in years — its setup page still lists Outlook Express. Re-check these values against Juno before relying on them.
